admin.title: Time of Magic
admin.description: Adds a touch of magic to your Flarum site.
admin.color_description: Leave empty to use your forum color. Examples: #E7672E, #00a185, red, rgb(255,0,0).
admin.progress_bar_description: Shows a thin progress bar below the header while scrolling.
admin.back_to_top_description: Shows a floating button to scroll back to top.
admin.back_to_top_shape_description: Use square shape instead of circle.
admin.snow_description: Adds a festive falling snow effect across the site.
admin.scrollbar_description: Replaces the default scrollbar with a thin themed one.
admin.swap_layout_description: Moves the sidebar to the right and posts to the left.
admin.click_spark_description: A burst of magic particles at the click position.
admin.background_description: Subtle background pattern that works on both light and dark themes.
